OCT. 25, 2001 | Rep. George French of Monticello, Ark., met Tuesday with Chancellor I. Dodd Wilson, M.D., and the incoming dean of the College of Medicine.

Rep. French is chairman of the Joint Budget Committee of the Arkansas General Assembly. E. Albert Reece, M.D., Ph.D., M.B.A., of Temple University is the incoming dean of medicine at the University of Arkansas for Medical Sciences.


Chancellor Wilson, Rep. French, and Dr. Reece met over lunch Tuesday. (Kevin Christensen, UAMS Media Services)
